description: Build a GridKit theme: start from a preset, tune every token on a live grid in light and dark, and download one CSS file for Tailwind or plain CSS.
title: Theme builder
intro: Start from a preset and tune the grid's tokens on a live preview, in light and dark. What you download is one small CSS file of overrides, loaded after the theme's stylesheet.

presets.heading: Preset
presets.replace: Replace your changes with {preset}? They are kept only in this page's address.

palette.heading: Palette from one accent
palette.intro: Pick an accent to get the accent, selection and hover colours for both palettes. Each keeps its default lightness, so text on it stays readable.
